description: Deterministic vectors for every logic symbol in OpenVP_Logic_Test.smw. Steps run in order: set = drive signals; expect = must hold right after the previous step settles; eventually = must hold within timeout_ms; wait_ms = sleep; expect_count_high = exactly N of these digital signals high. confidence: high = documented Crestron behaviour; medium = behaviour or pin order inferred from real programs; load = only checks the symbol loads.
